### The Low Power Programmable Leader

## OUR PRODUCTS

Lattice low power FPGAs and easy-to-use software tools enable designers to innovate and reduce
development time for their Industrial, Automotive, Communications, Computing, and Consumer
applications.
[[TDQ-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][211]
**Lattice MachXO5-NX TDQ ** is industry’s first secure control FPGA with full CNSA 2.0 compliant and
post-quantum cryptography (PQC) support.
[[Product-Selector-Guide1]][212]
[Lattice FPGA Product Selector Guide][213] provides a quick and easy way to identify Lattice FPGA
devices, features, and specifications.
[[CrossLinkU-Board-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][214]
**CrossLinkU-NX Evaluation Board** is a platform for general purpose application development using
CrossLinkU-NX device, the first FPGA with hard USB2/3 (5Gbps) interface.
[ EXPLORE OUR PRODUCTS][215]

## OUR SOLUTION STACKS

Whether you're designing for a smart factory, advanced driver experiences, AI datacenters,
leading-edge telecom infrastructure, or connected home, Lattice Solution Stacks allow you to quickly
unleash your innovation.
[[Sentry-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][216]
The **Lattice Sentry solution stack** enables a cyber resilient and NIST SP 800-193 compliant PFR
solution with easy-to-use FPGA design tools and a full suite of custom design services.
[[mVision-356x208-thumbnail]][217]
The **Lattice mVision solution stack ** helps embedded vision system designers to evaluate, develop,
and deploy FPGA-based embedded vision applications, such as machine vision, robotics, ADAS, video
surveillance, and drones.
[[sensAI-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][218]
The **Lattice sensAI solution stack** includes everything you need to evaluate, develop, and deploy
FPGA-based Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence solutions.
[ EXPLORE MORE SOLUTIONS][219]

### The Low Power Programmable Leader

## OUR PRODUCTS

Lattice low power FPGAs and easy-to-use software tools enable designers to innovate and reduce
development time for their Industrial, Automotive, Communications, Computing, and Consumer
applications.
[[TDQ-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][211]
**Lattice MachXO5-NX TDQ ** is industry’s first secure control FPGA with full CNSA 2.0 compliant and
post-quantum cryptography (PQC) support.
[[Product-Selector-Guide1]][212]
[Lattice FPGA Product Selector Guide][213] provides a quick and easy way to identify Lattice FPGA
devices, features, and specifications.
[[CrossLinkU-Board-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][214]
**CrossLinkU-NX Evaluation Board** is a platform for general purpose application development using
CrossLinkU-NX device, the first FPGA with hard USB2/3 (5Gbps) interface.
[ EXPLORE OUR PRODUCTS][215]

## OUR SOLUTION STACKS

Whether you're designing for a smart factory, advanced driver experiences, AI datacenters,
leading-edge telecom infrastructure, or connected home, Lattice Solution Stacks allow you to quickly
unleash your innovation.
[[Sentry-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][216]
The **Lattice Sentry solution stack** enables a cyber resilient and NIST SP 800-193 compliant PFR
solution with easy-to-use FPGA design tools and a full suite of custom design services.
[[mVision-356x208-thumbnail]][217]
The **Lattice mVision solution stack ** helps embedded vision system designers to evaluate, develop,
and deploy FPGA-based embedded vision applications, such as machine vision, robotics, ADAS, video
surveillance, and drones.
[[sensAI-Product-356x208-thumbnail]][218]
The **Lattice sensAI solution stack** includes everything you need to evaluate, develop, and deploy
FPGA-based Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence solutions.
[ EXPLORE MORE SOLUTIONS][219]

## Global innovation, local expertise

Bosch delivers semiconductor and sensor solutions that make mobility safer, more efficient, and
sustainable. On our website, you can explore detailed information about our products, services, and
innovative solutions for the automotive industry.

By combining global innovation with local expertise, we create tailored solutions for connected,
autonomous, and eco-friendly mobility.

# Electric Rate Case Application Information

Submission Date: June 2, 2026

Bill changes affect everyone differently, and you deserve clear, honest information when changes
happen. With aging infrastructure and changing weather patterns, work is needed to secure Michigan’s
grid – and that work comes at a cost. On Jun. 2, 2026, we asked the Michigan Public Service
Commission to approve new electric rates to cover these costs. If approved, the average home with a
monthly electric bill of $155 would see an estimated monthly increase of $13 (9%) starting in May
2027.

[Get more detailed information][61]

# Natural Gas Rate Case Application Information

Submission Date: Dec. 16, 2025

Bill changes affect everyone differently, and you deserve clear, honest information when changes
happen. With aging infrastructure and changing weather patterns, work is needed to secure Michigan’s
grid – and that work comes at a cost. On Dec. 16, 2025, we asked the Michigan Public Service
Commission to approve new natural gas rates to cover these costs. If approved, the average home with
a monthly natural gas bill of $88 would see an estimated monthly increase of $7.21 (8.2%) starting
in November 2026.

## Driver management tool for PC

**Driver Booster Free** is a free [utility][185] PC program by IObit. It is a [Windows tool][186]
that helps users manage the drivers necessary for all their devices to work properly. It boasts
support for over 1,000 major global hardware brands and ensures each one is the latest version, to
keep up with **new features and bug fixes**.

### Top Recommended Alternative

[[Driver Booster Pro icon]

### Driver Booster Pro

Trial version

4
][187]

Comparable to [Driver Easy][188] and [DriverPack][189], Driver Booster Free can also help address
issues related to PC crashes caused by **faulty or outdated drivers**. It offers an optional **pro
version** **subscription** for added features and options, including auto backups, improved support
for Windows 11, and other gaming-related optimizations.

## Why download Driver Booster Free?

## Easily Stay Updated

Maintaining optimal performance on your PC is crucial whether you use your machine daily for work,
[gaming][190] or personal use. There’s nothing more frustrating than settling into work only to be
disrupted by software issues or missing drivers. Keep your productivity humming with Driver
Booster’s helpful features:
* Driver scanning, which checks your PC for outdated drivers
* It backs up past versions of your drivers if they need to be restored.
* Driver Booster can be used as a bug fix for common issues.

You can also set up Driver Booster to do automatic updates that work with your schedule, such as

### DriverPack is the most convenient and fastest way to configure a computer

The software is provided for free, and is suitable both for professionals and for beginners
[screenshot-1][screenshot-2]
The number of DriverPack users around the world keeps growing with every passing second

57,414,378

[Install all required drivers][4]
[Other DriverPack versions][5]
[landing-author-image]
Hello! My name is Artur Kuzyakov. I am the author and founder of DriverPack
From a small piece of software written on pure enthusiasm 8 years ago, we have transformed into the
company which has helped more than 40 million people worldwide to configure their computers!

During this time, our software has become incredibly faster and smarter. Today, DriverPack is the
largest database of unique drivers in the world, located on ultra high speed servers all over the
world. In order to perform the process of driver installation always quickly and with the highest
possible quality, we use machine learning technologies that makes our selection algorithm even
better and more accurate. We have managed to achieve all this in such a way that the software
remains absolutely free of charge, and everyone can use it.

My team and I are proud of our product, and we hope it will become your reliable assistant
in configuring any computer in the shortest possible time frame. We spend all our time in order
to save yours!

### Mass media publications about DriverPack

[publishers-logo-xbit]
DriverPack Solution is an interesting application, it contains a set of options that other software
solutions of the same type don’t provide. Any user can fix all the errors and set up proper
operation of the system and all its devices in just two clicks. At the moment, the number of drivers
in the DriverPack database has already exceeded 1.1 million entries, and they all have been tested
for safety. [Read more[arrow-icon]][6]
[publishers-logo-cnews]
Since the moment the very first version of the software was created, DriverPack Solution has been
very popular among users. The software is available for download absolutely for free. This
distinguishes DriverPack Solution from its competitors and attracts more and more new users. [Read
more[arrow-icon]][7]
[publishers-logo-chip]
With DriverPack it’s not a challenge at all to find the latest versions of the drivers for your
PC components. The most pleasant aspect is that a user doesn’t even have to do anything by himself.
This tool is completely automated and convenient in operation. [Read more[arrow-icon]][8]
[publishers-logo-pcmag]
DriverPack Protect will help protect your computer from malware and adware programs and plug-ins,
which even antivirus software and ad-blocking tools often fail to do. [Read more[arrow-icon]][9]
[publishers-logo-habr]
The need to seek and install drivers each time when you reinstall Windows is, in my opinion, one
of the most significant flaws of the entire Windows family. As far back as in 2008, I decided to fix
this problem and wrote my own software which was called DriverPack. Today, my product is used
by 40 million users all over the world, and I consider that the drivers problem in Windows has now
been solved, albeit by means of a third-party solution. [Read more[arrow-icon]][10]
[publishers-logo-computerra]
The new version provides a user with more tools for making up his own driver selection. It’s
an especially pressing issue for those who service computers and administer lots of different
hardware. Now it is possible to integrate any alternative driverpacks into DriverPack rather than
just removing the unnecessary. [Read more[arrow-icon]][11]
[publishers-logo-vc]
Thanks to the grapevine, this product has been translated by users into 45 languages without the
participation of our team. [Read more[arrow-icon]][12]
[publishers-logo-secretfirmy]
Today, DriverPack has the largest driver database in the world which is translated to 45 languages
and operates on the computers of more than 42 million users. [Read more[arrow-icon]][13]

[publishers-logo-habr]

of the most significant flaws of the entire Windows family. As far back as in 2008, I decided to fix

by 40 million users all over the world, and I consider that the drivers problem in Windows has now
been solved, albeit by means of a third-party solution. [Read more[arrow-icon]][10]
[publishers-logo-computerra]
The new version provides a user with more tools for making up his own driver selection. It’s
an especially pressing issue for those who service computers and administer lots of different
hardware. Now it is possible to integrate any alternative driverpacks into DriverPack rather than
just removing the unnecessary. [Read more[arrow-icon]][11]
[publishers-logo-vc]
Thanks to the grapevine, this product has been translated by users into 45 languages without the
participation of our team. [Read more[arrow-icon]][12]
[publishers-logo-secretfirmy]

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:

  high-level business objectives.

  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.

  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.

  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.

solution for next generation avionics and military data bus applications.

Holt Integrated Circuits today announced the HI 6141, a highly integrated, single chip MIL STD 1553
terminal solution that supports both standard 1 Mbps MIL STD 1553 and 10 Mbps EBR 1553 / MMSI data
rates. The HI 6141 uses a 16-bit parallel host interface and combines the proven architectures of
Holt’s HI 6130 and HI 6140 devices into a single part, offering designers a flexible, pin selectable
solution for next generation avionics and military data bus applications.
[details][112]
[ARINC 429 Quad Line Driver Evaluation Board][113] -Thursday, March 5, 2026
Holt Integrated Circuits today announced the release of the ADK 85104 Evaluation Board, a compact,
ready to use platform designed to help engineers rapidly evaluate and characterize Holt’s HI 85104,
the world’s first fault isolated quad ARINC 429 line driver. In addition to short circuit
protection, the HI-85104 provides integrated 37.5 ohm impedance matched outputs with on chip fuses,
output tri state capability when powered on or off, and optional zero Ohm AMP outputs for external
lightning protection networks.
[details][114]

[details][116]

Holt Integrated Circuits today announced the HI-85104, the world’s first quad ARINC 429 line driver,
enabling aerospace designers to achieve higher channel density while reducing board area, component
count, and design complexity. The HI-85104 integrates four fully independent ARINC 429 transmit
channels into a compact 6 mm × 6 mm QFN package, replacing four discrete single-channel line drivers
with a single device.

# Drivers, user manuals and service manuals

NoDevice is a huge multilingual catalogue of free Windows drivers, user manuals and service manuals
for computer and device adjustment and repair.

Drivers are needed to ensure correct operation of video cards, printers, monitors, network cards,
sound cards, motherboards and other computer accessories and devices. There are about 100 thousand
drivers available for free downloading at NoDevice.

User manuals are needed to understand devices' operation principle and get to know all functions, as
well as for devices' proper adjustment. There are more than 120 thousand free user manuals in PDF
format at NoDevice database.

Service manuals are needed to do devices' repair. In our catalogue there are thousands of circuit
diagrams and schematics, replacement hardware lists, detailed service guides and repair manuals.

All files available at NoDevice are taken from manufacturers' official websites and tested with
antivirus software. All downloads are free.

### **Our Expertise and Experience
### **

Formed in 2008, we strive to meet the demands of UK System Houses, Building Owners, Managers,
Consultants and Occupants by providing open source solutions that communicate with all building
systems.

The Niagara Framework is a forward-thinking integration method that provides an all-inclusive
overview of a buildings performance, which assists in optimising and controlling the smart
technology within to improve energy consumption, reduce operational costs and improve occupant
wellbeing.

Our extensive experience working with the Niagara Framework across BMS and IoT, Product Selection
and our own in-house expert IT Developers, make us best placed in the market to deliver complete
solutions to our customers and their integration projects.

maximise their buildings potential. Our Tridium courses across certifications, security, networks,
advanced IoT integration and MSI training set the bar for the industry.

**By acting as an independent technical authority, the MSI removes silos between vendors, simplifies
delivery and handover, and enables smart, efficient buildings that perform from day one and adapt
for the future.**

### **Explore the MSI Role with One Sight**

We help clients with Big Data, IT Networks, BIM, BMS and Cloud Integration

From Design to Deployment, we have the expertise to help deliver award-winning integrations for
Energy Efficiency, Occupant Wellbeing and Operational use cases.

A New Platform for better Smart Enablement through Time-saving and Risk Reduction

# **OSS Drivers for Tridium** Niagara 4/5

#### **We help you simplify integration, boost engineering productivity, and accelerate project
#### delivery**

**Developed from years of experience, our 11x Niagara Drivers help you to Stop Fighting the Clock
and Skillset Gaps, all whilst Maximising Project ROI and Niagara Efficiency**

We recognise Tridium Niagara 4 as the gold standard for Smart Building integration, but today’s
projects demand more than just a BMS. Clients expect seamless API integration, scalable IoT
connectivity, and automated reporting. These aren’t limitations – they’re opportunities to maximise
the value of Niagara even further to delivery the best projects.

[Get Your Free Trial of All 11x Drivers Now][79]

### **We’re at the forefront of the most demanding building industry

#### **Making buildings smarter through automated energy management, occupant wellbeing and

### **Our Expertise and Experience
### **

Formed in 2008, we strive to meet the demands of UK System Houses, Building Owners, Managers,
Consultants and Occupants by providing open source solutions that communicate with all building
systems.

The Niagara Framework is a forward-thinking integration method that provides an all-inclusive
overview of a buildings performance, which assists in optimising and controlling the smart
technology within to improve energy consumption, reduce operational costs and improve occupant
wellbeing.

Our extensive experience working with the Niagara Framework across BMS and IoT, Product Selection
and our own in-house expert IT Developers, make us best placed in the market to deliver complete
solutions to our customers and their integration projects.

#### every project scenario**

As a Tridium Platinum Distributor, we stock the widest range of Niagara compatible hardware and
software on the market. Our vast industry experience for product selection, technical support and
customer service has resulted in us having a solution for virtually every use case.
Our in-house team of industry leading software developers expand integration possibilities and
improve productivity through our exlusive software tools. Niagara drivers, LoRaWAN and IoT sensor
solutions, Site Surveys, Data & Cloud Integration and IT Infrastructure.
From our involvement within Smart Building integrations and MSI role, we understand how clients can
maximise their buildings potential. Our Tridium courses across certifications, security, networks,
advanced IoT integration and MSI training set the bar for the industry.

#### Quote now & get covered for as low as $100/year^{**}

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.

[Learn more about boat][34]

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][36]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][37]

#### Cover yourself for everything your condo association doesn't

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you
can be covered for theft, damage, and more. Get a quote today for greater peace of mind.

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

#### Ride with the #1 bike insurer starting at $75/year^{§}

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][42]

#### Pet insurance

Affordable coverage for your four-legged friend

With Progressive Pet Insurance by Pets Best, you can create a plan that fits your dog or cat's
needs, as well as your budget. Simply choose a plan and then customize your deductible,
reimbursement percentage, and annual limit.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

#### Protect yourself from damage, theft, and more

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,
or storage locker. Plus, if you can't stay in your residence due to a covered incident, we'll help
pay for your temporary living expenses. Get covered today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

[Learn more about renters][44]

#### Join a leading RV insurer starting at $125/year^{††}

Whether you're a full-time RVer or an occasional road-tripper, you'll find all the coverages you
need at an affordable price right here. Get a quote now and enjoy the open road without worry.

**Why Progressive?:** From windshield & glass coverage to emergency expenses, we have your road trip
covered.

[Learn more about RV][45]

#### Umbrella insurance

Extra coverage for all your assets

Umbrella insurance provides an extra layer of liability coverage beyond what your home and auto
policy offer, with limits available up to $5 million.

[Learn more about umbrella insurance][46]

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][47]

with both policies under one roof, you can update or make changes to your insurance with ease. Quote
now to get started.

[Learn more about bundling][48]

#### Bundle and save an average of 7% on auto in most states!^{Δ}

When you combine Progressive auto and condo insurance, you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ}
And with those extra savings comes the convenience of managing both your policies through one
company. Quote now to see the savings.

[Learn more about bundling][49]

With both an auto and renters policy, you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ} Plus, you'll enjoy

and ease of bundled insurance.

30 Years experience working with motor control applications in your industry

### Printing

Applications for printing press drives – unroll, printing cylinder drive, impression roller drive,
sheet & folder drive, rewind.

Applications used in reel drives, spool drives, wire drawing, twisting, stranding, coiling,

steel foundries and copper foundries.

Vestel Group has thirty-five owned and licensed brands globally. As our global brand, "Vestel" is

Vestel Elektronik is one of the leading players in consumer electronics, household appliances and

### Our Brands

Vestel Group has thirty-five owned and licensed brands globally. As our global brand, "Vestel" is
among Türkiye’s leading brands and is ranked seventh by brand value, according to Brand Finance.

### Investor Relations

Vestel Elektronik is one of the leading players in consumer electronics, household appliances and
digital products in Europe with its almost 16,000 employees and 31 companies, of which 20 are based
abroad. Founded in 1997, Vestel Beyaz Eşya is today one of the top 3 white goods producers in Turkey
and among the 5 largest white goods manufacturers in Europe.

Zorlu Holding’s sustainability approach, The Smart Life 2030 vision, as a guide to lead us through
this journey.
